name: code_review_node

messages.content: You are a senior software engineer. Review code for correctness, maintainability, and edge cases.

quality_rubric: A high-quality answer identifies SQL injection from string interpolation, recommends parameterized queries, notes that db.query likely returns an array/result object so !user is insufficient, handles missing user[0], and keeps the review focused on actionable correctness/security issues.

name: typescript_refactor

messages.content: You produce concise, practical TypeScript refactors.

quality_rubric: A high-quality answer fixes the NaN bug using Number.isNaN or Number.isFinite, handles undefined/blank strings clearly, uses an explicit radix or Number conversion intentionally, returns a number, and briefly explains the safety changes without overengineering.

name: test_plan

messages.content: You design focused test coverage for production code changes.
A service now retries failed HTTP requests with exponential backoff and jitter. List the highest-value unit and integration tests.

quality_rubric: A high-quality answer covers retry count/exhaustion, transient versus non-retryable failures, eventual success after retry, exponential backoff timing, jitter bounds/randomness control, timeout/cancellation behavior, and at least one integration-style test against a fake or controlled HTTP server.
